import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    inp,out=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    diff=[(i,j,inp[i][j],out[i][j]) for i in range(len(inp)) for j in range(len(inp[0])) if inp[i][j]!=out[i][j]]
    print(k, 'marker cells:', sorted((i,j) for i in range(len(inp)) for j in range(len(inp[0])) if inp[i][j]==5) if k!='Demo pair 3' else sorted((i,j) for i in range(len(inp)) for j in range(len(inp[0])) if inp[i][j]==8))
    print(' changed:', diff)
    print()

        if len(v)>=2 and len(ns)>1:

    if not best: return [list(r) for r in g]
    ns,v=best
    v=sorted(v)  # by top row
